historical_sources.title: FRUS: The Czechoslovak Leadership, August 1979
historical_sources.supports: Differences between cautious pragmatists and ideological hardliners, oil dependence and the limits of contemporary reporting. This is a contemporary intelligence assessment, not a definitive personal manifesto.

historical_sources.title: Library of Congress: Czechoslovakia, A Country Study
historical_sources.supports: Federal institutions, National Front satellites, normalisation and economic context.

historical_sources.title: Czech Academy of Sciences: Dictionary Handbook, 1948-1989
historical_sources.supports: Distinct satellite parties and chair chronology, including Michal Žákovič for Strana slobody.

historical_sources.title: Prague Castle: Václav Havel
historical_sources.supports: Charter 77, Civic Forum in November 1989, presidency and the later federal dispute.

historical_sources.title: Slovak National Gallery: Public Against Violence archive
historical_sources.supports: VPN as a separate Slovak civic movement of 1989.

historical_sources.title: Christian Democratic Movement: official history
historical_sources.supports: KDH formation in 1990 and Christian-democratic identity.

historical_sources.title: Slovak National Party: official history
historical_sources.supports: 1990 organisation. Treat the party history as an interested source, not neutral interpretation.

historical_sources.title: Czech Academy of Sciences: Social Democracy, 1989-92
historical_sources.supports: Restoration and competing social-democratic traditions.

historical_sources.title: IMF: Czechoslovakia, An Economy in Transition
historical_sources.supports: Industrial strengths, command-economy problems and the transition context. Game balance percentages are not historical statistics.

historical_sources.title: Czech Sociological Review: living standards and late socialism
historical_sources.supports: Consumption, social provision and the limits of the late-socialist material bargain.

historical_sources.title: World Bank: Czechoslovak environmental assessment
historical_sources.supports: Industrial pollution, health burdens and environmental damage. Proposed health-budget modifiers are a game abstraction.

historical_sources.title: World Bank: Czechoslovakia energy report
historical_sources.supports: Coal-dependent generation and the northern Bohemian industrial environment.

historical_sources.title: MERO: Druzhba pipeline history
historical_sources.supports: Czechoslovak supply from 1962, Litvínov connection in 1965 and pipeline development.

historical_sources.title: IAEA: Nuclear power development and cooperation history
historical_sources.supports: VVER decision, component specialisation and investment-linked Khmelnytskyi power cooperation.

historical_sources.title: 1977 Gabčíkovo-Nagymaros treaty text
historical_sources.supports: Joint capital obligations, power/navigation goals and environmental responsibilities. Three-year game construction and GDP shares are proposed adaptations.

historical_sources.title: UN Treaty Series: Prague Treaty, 1973
historical_sources.supports: Normalisation of relations and agreed cooperation fields.

historical_sources.title: UN Treaty Series: Industrial and technical cooperation, 1975
historical_sources.supports: Industrial plants, licences, patents, training and specialisation.

historical_sources.title: Austria: Official 1974 property-claims treaty publication
historical_sources.supports: One billion ATS settlement with export-linked instalments. The one-time GDP-priced proposal is a game adaptation, not that historical formula.

historical_sources.title: Volkswagen Group historical study: automobile cooperation
historical_sources.supports: 1971 Czechoslovak-GDR cooperation negotiations and narrower later component exchange.

historical_sources.title: Slovak Museum of the Victims of Communism: the secret church
historical_sources.supports: Slovak Catholic lay networks. No invented Muslim political routes.

historical_sources.title: US Helsinki Commission: Charter 77 documents
historical_sources.supports: A rights initiative, not a fictitious 1970 political party.

historical_sources.title: Institute of National Memory: 1989, A Year of Change
historical_sources.supports: Late-1989 civic and party formation context. A 1970 Green organisation is explicitly alternate history.

historical_sources.title: UN Treaty Series: Soviet-Czechoslovak treaty, 1970
historical_sources.supports: The historical framework of political, economic and scientific cooperation. A sovereignty renegotiation is a proposed alternative.

historical_sources.title: Škoda Group: industrial history
historical_sources.supports: Czechoslovak transport-engineering and locomotive production heritage. Game bonuses are proposed abstractions.

historical_sources.title: Czech Government: Černík cabinet and its ministers
historical_sources.supports: Černík-to-Štrougal office chronology. The party chief and president are separate offices.
